purpose: ONE canonical project graph per project; the founder tree and the client tree are filtered projections of it. Never two manual trees.

fields.node_type: PROJECT | PHASE | FAMILY | PARENT_SCREEN | CHILD_SCREEN | GRANDCHILD_SCREEN | KEY_INTERACTION | STATE | SHARED_SYSTEM | EXTERNAL_HANDOFF | INTERNAL
fields.label: product language
fields.implementation_status: PLANNED | IN_PRODUCTION | IMPLEMENTED | LIVE | CONNECTED | COMPLETE | BLOCKED
fields.client_visible: derived by filter rules + founder override

fields.relationship: NAVIGATES_TO | OPENS | DEPENDS_ON | UNLOCKS | RETURNS_TO | SHARES_SYSTEM | REQUIRES_APPROVAL_BEFORE | DATA_FLOWS_TO | HANDS_OFF_TO
fields.label: human action ("TAP START SETUP")

derivation_sources.family_manifests: FamilyProductionContract (shared/site00-product-families): screens role PARENT/CHILD/GRANDCHILD → screen nodes; interactions → KEY_INTERACTION nodes + edges; dataObjects → SHARED_SYSTEM nodes
derivation_sources.live_route_matrix: ParentChildRouteGraph (shared/site00-studio-world-production/parentChildExperienceInheritance/types.ts) → route + edge verification (LIVE vs BROKEN)

mappings.gate_edges: Approval gate model emits REQUIRES_APPROVAL_BEFORE / UNLOCKS between FAMILY nodes (e.g. F01 → F02).

persistence: Derived and cached per project (materialised graph rows or JSON snapshot rebuilt on family manifest change, approval event, route-matrix run). Not hand-edited; founder overrides stored as a small override table (label, client_visible, importance).
realtime: Rebuild + push on LIVE / APPROVED / SUPERSEDED / BLOCKED transitions (same event stream as pulse/notifications).
